description: This file defines the Supervisor display field class in the OrangeHRM system, part of the reporting module. It extends functionality for displaying supervisor-related data in reports, specifying associated DTO class, fields, and entity aliases.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: A display field class for supervisor data in reports, extending ListableDisplayField, providing specific DTO class, fields, and entity alias configurations.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field identifiers that this display field will handle, in this case, employee number.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides entity alias mappings used in queries, here mapping 'supervisor' as the alias.
